verdict.rationale: No evidence of data retention or deletion controls for AI-native usage — sandbox reset (deel-docs-5) only deletes test/sample data in a separate testing environment, not production or agent-exposed data. No docs describe data retention policies, deletion APIs, or GDPR-style erasure controls; community comments (deel-comm-1) reflect general distrust but do not concretely confirm or deny a specific retention/deletion feature.
